canada.title: Yellowknife RCMP asking for help finding missing 31-year-old
canada.summary: Yellowknife RCMP are asking for the public’s help to find a missing 31-year-old man, who was last seen in the area of the Stanton Territorial Hospital earlier in October.

canada.title: Dorval mayor extends condolences to Inuit community after man dies near Ullivik Centre
canada.summary: Montreal police say a 69-year-old man has died after being struck by an SUV in the West Island suburb of Dorval. The collision occurred near the Ullivik Centre, which houses Inuit patients from Nunavik seeking medical treatment in Montreal.

canada.title: Fact-checking the B.C. NDP's record — and major parties' promises — on seniors care
canada.summary: The B.C. NDP promised to add 5,400 new long-term care beds to the system in 2024. They also pledged to expand access to home care, to enable seniors who want to live at home to continue to do so. Here’s a look at what they delivered and what the major parties are promising to do if elected.

canada.summary: The alleged co-conspirator in the mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., is expected to enter a plea at an arraignment in a Seattle courthouse Thursday.

canada.title: Kevin Klein didn't need to win a debate, he only needed to sideline Mike Vogiatzakis
canada.summary: Kevin Klein's main objective Wednesday was to present himself as the only viable alternative to incumbent candidate Scott Gillingham. Klein missed that opportunity in the morning but succeeded over the supper hour.

canada.title: Officials to provide update on fatal fire at CFB Wainwright in Alberta
canada.summary: Officials are set to provide an update today about a devastating fire at a Canadian military base in Alberta that left four soldiers dead and dozens more injured.

canada.title: Mount Allison brings back teaching-degree program nearly 30 years after nixing it
canada.summary: The university will offer a 16-month post-baccalaureate degree with options to teach either grades K to 5 or 6 to 12.

canada.title: Teacher shortage in Happy Valley-Goose Bay linked to housing shortage, says NLTA president
canada.summary: The president of the NLTA says two teachers gave up jobs in Happy Valley-Goose Bay this year because they couldn't find housing—and he's calling on the provincial government to offer clear solutions.
